releaseNotes: v0.1.3 (beta): Sign-in now uses Roborock's current login (with the user agreement version), fixing accounts that were refused with a user agreement error. Clearer sign-in messages (bad code, agreement needed, wrong region, too many codes). App page now matches the other integrations: status banner, Connected/Offline tag per vacuum, the protocol actually in use, and listing under Integrations. Driver: fixed the install error (Cannot get property 'id' on null object). v0.1.0 (beta): First build. Local control of Roborock vacuums over the vacuum's own TCP port, no cloud after a one-time sign-in. Supports the newer L01 protocol (Qrevo Curv and similar) and the older 1.0 protocol. Attribute and command names match bloodtick's Roborock driver so existing rules carry over.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Roborock Integration
apps.description: Signs in to Roborock once to bring in your vacuums, their local keys and room names, and creates a device for each.

drivers.name: Roborock Vacuum
drivers.description: One vacuum, controlled locally: status, start, dock, pause, room cleaning, fan and mop modes, consumables.
